payload.title: Image processing is capped and its engine is swappable
payload.context: Images review (#25): a few kilobytes of upload could make the web container allocate gigabytes, because the throttle counted requests and not concurrency; and GD cannot convert colour profiles.
payload.rationale: Decoding runs inside processing slots: two on the instance and one per user, held as leases that expire, answering 429 with a short Retry-After when full. ImageProcessor is an interface with GD as its one implementation, and header checks, limits and the JPEG readers are plain PHP, so another engine is one class.
payload.consequences: The web container needs about 1.3 GB for images with the default of two slots. Colour profiles are dropped until an engine that converts them is chosen.
